author.name: Hammad Ulhaq
author.role: Head of Supply Chain · 20+ yrs FMCG & Beverages

slides.title: Pallet-first is a *habit*, not a project
slides.body: From hand-loaded to pallet-first in 5 steps

slides.title: Measure it in *cases*
bullets: Rate = cases dispatched on pallets ÷ total cases dispatched
Count cases, not pallets, or hand-loading hides

slides.title: Know your real *starting* point
bullets: Track the rate daily, by shift and by route
List which loads still go by hand, and why
Set a monthly target the team can see

slides.title: Build pallets that *fit* the truck
bullets: Standard patterns per SKU and pack
Match pallet count to the truck bed
Stretch wrap so loads survive the road

slides.title: Agree how pallets get *off*
bullets: Check each customer can receive pallets
Plan pallet returns and swaps up front
Keep hand-loading as the exception, logged

slides.title: Make pallet-first the *default*
bullets: Pick and stage by pallet, not by case
Train loaders and supervisors on the new SOP
Review every hand-loaded truck next morning

slides.title: Change the default, then *track* it daily
slides.body: Save this for your next review.
